summary: Vaxcyte, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $500M equity offering of 7,412,500 common shares and 400,000 pre-funded warrants at $64.00 per share, a discount to the $66.70 last sale on October 6, 2026. Underwriters received a 30-day option for 1,171,875 additional shares; net proceeds before expenses totaled about $473.75M. The offering is concurrent, but not contingent, on a separate $500M convertible senior notes due 2032 offering with a $75M option. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
